title: AI Film Compilation: Kelly Boesch’s AI Short Films & Music Videos - 4k
description:
👉 If you like my work, I post new AI art and cinematic videos daily, subscribe to follow the journey.

Enjoy a compilation of Kelly Boesch’s AI short films and AI music videos,   a curated collection of visual pieces, each with its own world, mood, and cinematic style. This video brings together many of Kelly’s AI creations into one seamless viewing experience, designed for inspiration, ambience, creativity, and deep visual immersion.

Each short film features original AI-generated visuals and music paired with Kelly’s unique artistic direction, blending surreal dreamscapes, emotional storytelling, and music-driven motion.

This is not one continuous film,  it is a collection of multiple AI short films and AI music videos assembled into a 60-minute compilation for extended watching.

Legal: © 2025 Kelly Boesch
